# Marck CRM Analytics

> Public web application and professional portfolio for Marck Ali, Account Manager and CRM Analytics Specialist.

## Primary routes

- App: https://marckali-creator.github.io/marck-crm-analytics/
  - Browser-based CRM and merchant analytics dashboard.
  - Supports lead paste/import, quarterly Store ID deduplication, analytics timeframes, campaign recommendations, outreach notes, dispositions, and calendar handoff.
  - The public build contains fictional demo merchants only.
  - User-imported leads, notes, reports, and preferences remain in that browser's local storage.

- Portfolio: https://marckali-creator.github.io/marck-crm-analytics/portfolio.html
  - Professional overview, selected impact metrics, partner success case study, competencies, scheduling, and contact details.

## Contact and scheduling

- Schedule: https://doordashddmx.orthisbe.com/c/marck-aliext-doordash-com-lem

## Usage notes

- This static site does not provide a public API.
- Do not infer that demo merchant records represent real businesses.
- Do not expose or request browser-local CRM data without the user's explicit authorization.
